evidence.title: AgentMail - YC company profile
evidence.excerpt: AgentMail is the first email provider for AI agents. Use our API to give your agents their own email inboxes. We started building email agents because they can live within users’s inboxes in their inboxes and authenticate themselves with third-party applications. But building on top of legacy providers such as Gmail is a struggle. They These providers don’t scale with both inbox creation or volumes of emails sent/received that AI agents often face, so we’re rebuilding email infrastructure from scratch to enable this. AgentMail is an API-first email provider that gives agents their own inboxes to send, receive, and act upon emails. Think of it like Gmail, but with In this demo, we show how easy it is to build an email agent with AgentMail: https://youtu.be/1V7BISeFUTM In this demo, we show an example of a voice + email agent built with AgentMail: https://youtu.be/eG2fCsRK4RY If you are building agents that could use email capabilities, we would love to learn more about your company. You can reach us at founders@agentmail.cc

evidence.title: Customer Stories | AgentMail
evidence.excerpt: How teams building AI agents give them real email inboxes with AgentMail. Lanesurf is an AI platform for freight brokers and trucking that automates load matching, carrier communication, and dispatch. Their agents run high-volume carrier conversations over email. Hundreds of programmatic inboxes, millions of messages, thousands of loads a day. Alchemy built AgentCard, spend-controlled one-time-use credit cards that let AI agents pay for anything online. Purchases run on email, so every AgentCard agent gets an AgentMail inbox by default. ~70% increase in agentic transactions post-integration. Junior, by Kuse, is an AI employee that lives in Slack, Teams, Lark, and email. Every AI employee needed a real email identity for two-way conversations. Building it in-house was weeks of work; AgentMail made email a first-class channel in under a week. Locus Founder builds storefronts, sources products, runs ads, and handles vendor payments through an on-chain wallet. Each agent in the fleet gets its own AgentMail inbox so the world can actually reach it. Eragon is a centralized AI workspace that powers org-wide business intelligence. Their workspace agents needed email as both an input and an output, inbound to ingest as a knowledge source, outbound to act on insights. AgentMail provided the inbox. DoAnything is a general-purpose AI agent that does the work for you. Email was the last piece its agents needed to be real citizens online, an identity, trust, and a way to act in the world. AgentMail is the inbox behind it. Pancake is a superagent that runs autonomous squads for your company. They needed an inbox the agent fully owned, not a founder's personal address. Shipped in a day, zero-touch threads, response times from hours to minutes. Browser Use is the open-source framework for AI agents that control a browser. Every Browser Use Cloud session now ships with its own AgentMail inbox, so agents can sign up, verify, and stay logged in with no human in the loop. AISDR is a fully autonomous AI SDR. Hundreds of AgentMail inboxes in production, thousands of emails per week, no human in the loop. Balance built Bea, an AI accountant serving 50+ SMB customers across Europe. They needed programmatic inboxes with whitelists, blacklists, and EU hosting. Half a day per inbox became a single API call. Every Dossium user gets a dedicated AgentMail inbox provisioned automatically before they finish signing up. General Intelligence built Cofounder, a multi-agent workspace where each agent runs a department. They needed real inboxes per agent, not just a send API. 800+ emails through agent inboxes in week one. Subscribe to our weekly newsletter. © 2026 AgentMail, Inc. All rights reserved.
